entities.summary: The Liberal–National Coalition, commonly known as the Coalition or the LNP, is an alliance of conservative and centre-right to right-wing political parties in Australia. Its primary members are the Liberal Party of Australia and the National Party of Australia. It is one of the two major parties in Australian politics, its main rival being the Australian Labor Party. The Coalition was last in government federally from 2013 to 2022.
